papers.title_en: From Human Videos to Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Data: Confidence-Guided RL Refinement of Video Priors
papers.authors: Yanghong Liu, Yang Chen, Kailang Xu, Bang Du, Feiyang Yang, Jiawei Xia, Zhengtao Yao, Yubiao Zhang, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Ruihai Wu, Wei Zhan
papers.evidence: 强化学习将人类视频先验转化为机器人灵巧抓取与操作示范
papers.tldr: 双手灵巧操作示范采集成本高，人类视频虽可提供数据来源，却存在运动估计不确定和人机形态差异，直接迁移难以执行。PriDex从人机交互中提取抓取线索，并结合物体轨迹与双腕相对运动作为任务先验。它依据物体运动置信度调节两类先验的权重，再用仿真强化学习在机器人运动学与物理约束下细化动作，生成机器人示范。研究在倒水、扫入簸箕、拧瓶盖和擦盘任务中评估数据生成及视觉策略学习，展示了将视频先验转化为训练数据的框架。
papers.abstract_en: Collecting demonstrations for bimanual dexterous manipulation is costly, motivating the use of human videos as a source of robot training data. However, uncertainty in video-derived motion estimates and differences between human and robot embodiments make direct motion transfer challenging. In this work, we introduce PriDex, a framework that transforms human-video Priors into executable robot Dexterous manipulation demonstrations through reinforcement learning in simulation. PriDex preserves task-relevant interaction structure while allowing embodiment-specific behavior to be regenerated for the robot. Human-object interactions provide affordance cues for selecting task-relevant, robot-specific grasps from geometry-based candidates. For motion refinement, object trajectories provide a task-level reference, while relative bimanual wrist trajectories offer complementary guidance for coordinated motion. Since object-motion estimates can become unreliable under occlusion or visual ambiguity, PriDex uses object-motion confidence to adaptively balance these two priors, emphasizing object-level guidance when confidence is high and increasing the contribution of wrist-level guidance as confidence decreases. Reinforcement learning refines these video-derived priors under the robot's kinematic and physical constraints, and the resulting policies are rolled out to generate robot demonstrations for training a vision-based diffusion policy. We evaluate PriDex on four bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, including pouring, sweeping into a dustpan, bottle-cap unscrewing, and plate cleaning, assessing both simulation-based robot data generation and downstream visuomotor policy learning.

papers.title_en: DreamFAR: Real-Time and Long-Horizon Interaction with Diverse Objects
papers.authors: Yiming Dou, Botao He, Antonio Loquercio, Andrew Owens, Jitendra Malik, Sumedh Anand Sontakke, Ruoshi Liu
papers.evidence: 世界模型预测机器人操作中的接触、因果关系及长时域动作后果
papers.tldr: 机器人操控世界模型可用于模拟与评估操作，但现有方法常局限于单一环境，或难以预测长时程、接触密集的事件。DreamFAR从零开始使用大规模机器人原生遥操作数据训练动力学模型，不依赖互联网视频预训练，并采用适配此类数据的架构和训练方案。实验中，它在长时程未来预测上显著优于已有模型，且模型较小、能在商用GPU上以每秒10帧运行。研究展示了其用于策略评估与混合数据协同训练的潜力，为机器人操作提供了更实用的实时仿真模型。
papers.abstract_en: World models have shown great potential in serving as a simulator for robot manipulation. However, existing models are either fit to a single environment or lack ability to simulate long-horizon contact-rich events. We present DreamFAR, a world model whose dynamics model is trained from scratch on a large robot-native teleoperation dataset, with no internet-video pretraining. We present an architecture and learning recipe designed for training on robot-native data. DreamFAR is significantly smaller than the high-performance video generation models, yet shows better understanding of contact and causality, and runs 10 FPS on a commercial GPU. Experimentally, DreamFAR significantly outperforms existing models in predicting the long-horizon future. We further demonstrate various applications where DreamFAR can be used, including policy evaluation and mixed-data co-training. Project page: https://www.yimingdou.com/DreamFAR/

papers.title_en: Joint-ID: Transformer-based Joint Image Enhancement and Depth Estimation for Underwater Environments
papers.authors: Geonmo Yang, Gilhwan Kang, Juhui Lee, Younggun Cho
papers.evidence: Transformer联合图像增强与水下深度估计
papers.tldr: 水下散射、吸收和湍流会削弱图像颜色、纹理与清晰度，也使可靠深度信息难以获取，影响水下环境感知。论文提出 Transformer 模型 Joint-ID，在共享层级特征空间中联合增强图像并估计深度，同时设计针对无效深度、模糊和图像退化的多模态目标函数。作者构建含多种失真与场景深度的合成数据集，并在合成、标准数据集及复杂真实水下图像上评估方法。结果显示其兼顾增强与深度估计，并可用于特征匹配和显著性检测，体现了面向水下机器人视觉应用的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Underwater imaging is a challenging task due to factors such as scattering, absorption, and turbulence, which degrade image quality and limit visibility. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for enhancing underwater images that leverages the benefits of joint learning for simultaneous image enhancement and depth estimation. We introduce Joint-ID, a transformer-based neural network that can obtain high-perceptual image quality and depth information from raw underwater images. Our approach formulates a multi-modal objective function that addresses invalid depth, lack of sharpness, and image degradation based on color and local texture. We design an end-to-end training pipeline that enables joint restoration and depth estimation in a shared hierarchical feature space. Additionally, we propose a synthetic dataset with various distortions and scene depths for multi-task learning. We evaluate Joint-ID on synthetic and standard datasets, as well as real underwater images with diverse spectra and harsh turbidity, demonstrating its effectiveness for underwater image enhancement and depth estimation. Furthermore, we demonstrate the ability of Joint-ID to perform feature matching and saliency detection for visually guided underwater robots. Our proposed method has the potential to improve the visual perception of underwater environments and benefit applications such as oceanography and underwater robotics. Supplements are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/joint-id/home

papers.title_en: PhyVGGT: Feed-Forward Articulated Object Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
papers.authors: Qi Shao, Zhihao Cao, Shuhao Zhai, Anh Nguyen, Hong Liang, Baoru Huang, Liang Li
papers.evidence: 前馈式单目视频三维重建可动部件与关节
papers.tldr: 从未标定单目视频恢复可动部件、关节参数和未观测姿态，对机器人操作与数字孪生很重要，但现有优化方法耗时且常需深度或相机位姿。PhyVGGT基于冻结三维基础模型，以静态基座几何为锚点，分割并匹配部件，再闭式估计关节轴与铰链中心。模型仅用合成数据训练，在五个基准上取得领先单目性能，处理48帧视频仅需6.8秒。它将复杂的逐场景优化转为快速前馈重建，为单目场景下的关节物体理解提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing an articulated object with its 3D movable parts, joint parameters and unseen articulation states from an uncalibrated monocular video is essential for robot manipulation and interactive digital twins. Existing per-scene optimisation methods require minutes to hours and external depth or camera poses, whereas feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct dense point maps in one pass without segmenting movable parts or inferring joints. Even on these monocular point maps, regressing or fitting continuous joints directly fails on casual videos, since cross-frame attention blurs moving part boundaries in deep layers, underestimates motion along the viewing ray and leaves continuous axes ill-conditioned under small opening angles. To address these challenges, we propose PhyVGGT, a single-pass framework on a frozen 3D foundation model that anchors moving-part matching and closed-form joint estimation to the undistorted geometry of the stationary base. First, our Part and Motion Decoder fuses intermediate per-frame tokens with global tokens and references part queries to a static-base query to segment 3D parts, align point maps on the static base and predict learned Bingham priors. Second, our Kinematic Inference Layer fits an orthogonal Manhattan frame to static surface normals, selects the joint axis in closed form under a Bingham posterior combining pairwise motion scatter with the learned priors, and solves a linear system for the hinge pivot to drive unseen states. Trained solely on synthetic data, PhyVGGT achieves state-of-the-art monocular performance across five benchmarks, outperforming FAMOS and monocular ArtiPoint, surpassing posed RGB-D ArtiPoint in median error, and running in 6.8 s per 48-frame video against hours of per-scene optimisation in Articulat3D. Project page: https://phyvggt.github.io.

papers.title_en: Distilling World Action Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation via Anchored Path Matching
papers.authors: Jialong Liu, Junjie He, Yandu Chen, Bin Zhou, Heng Su, Peijun Tang, Jianan Wang, Changhao Chen
papers.evidence: 蒸馏联合生成未来视频和机器人动作的模型，用于双臂操作
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型联合生成未来视频与机器人动作，少步蒸馏虽能降低推理开销，却可能因更新粗糙而偏离教师轨迹。本文提出锚定路径匹配，从学生实际到达的状态出发，匹配教师预测的最终状态与首个中间状态，并在梯度冲突时优先保证终点目标。一个检查点即可支持一、二、四步生成，无需重新训练或查询教师。仅用 RoboTwin 2.0 的 Clean 演示训练，在 Clean 与 Random 单步成功率分别提升2.0和1.4个百分点，视频画质也有所改善；真实机器人任务中，控制周期延迟较八步教师降低21.3倍。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative denoising. Few-step distillation reduces the number of model evaluations, but its coarse updates can move the student away from the teacher's trajectory. We propose Anchored Path Matching (APM), which supervises endpoint and short-transition predictions from states reached by the student. From each state, we continue the teacher to zero noise and use its endpoint and first intermediate state as targets. Modality-routed adapters learn to match both targets from the same starting state. When the two gradients conflict, anchor-priority updates preserve the endpoint gradient and remove the opposing component of the local gradient within each modality. One checkpoint supports 1-, 2-, and 4-step joint generation. The sampling budget can be chosen at deployment without retraining or teacher queries. On RoboTwin 2.0, we train only on Clean demonstrations and evaluate directly on the domain-randomized Random setting. At one step, APM improves closed-loop success over continued base distillation at matched inference budgets by 2.0 percentage points on Clean and 1.4 on Random. Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS). On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step teacher.Project page: https://jialonglong.github.io/Anchored-Path-Matching/.

papers.title_en: Task Convergent Flow Matching for Generative Robotics
papers.authors: Lorenzo Paiola, Maximilian Stölzle, Giorgio Grioli, Daniela Rus, Cosimo Della Santina
papers.evidence: 针对机器人操作生成动作，并以物理仿真评估任务进展，直接契合具身操作与行动规划。
papers.tldr: 机器人操作需要让物体持续接近目标，但生成策略仅产生看似合理的动作，后续动作块可能停滞或逆转已有进展。论文提出推理时精炼框架，通过并行物理仿真评估动作块，并用任务漏斗限制暂时回退、要求每块取得净进展。方法以 CMA-ES 搜索流匹配源种子，并将搜索限制在源分布的径向分位区间，以兼顾接触丰富动力学与动作先验。PushT 和三立方体叠放成功率分别从31.3%升至88.5%、从77.0%升至86.0%；结果显示该方法能增强任务收敛性与执行可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Successful manipulation requires the manipulated objects to progress toward a desired task outcome. Generative policies can produce plausible robot motions without ensuring this progress, allowing successive action chunks to stall or undo earlier changes to the scene. We introduce a task-centric inference-time refinement framework for flow matching policies that evaluates candidate action chunks through parallel physics-based rollouts and searches for motions satisfying sufficient conditions for task convergence. Task-level performance funnels bound temporary regressions while requiring net progress over each chunk. We establish sufficient conditions under which repeated funnel satisfaction yields convergence throughout execution, and use interval-wise Lipschitz bounds to verify continuous-time funnel satisfaction from sampled rollouts. To accommodate contact-rich hybrid dynamics, we refine the flow's source seeds using derivative-free Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES), constrained to radial quantile bands of the source distribution to help retain the learned motion prior. This formulation supports both Euclidean and pose-valued Riemannian Flow Matching (RMFM) policies. On PushT and three-cube stacking, refinement raises success from 31.3% to 88.5% and from 77.0% to 86.0%. On PushT, whose coverage score responds continuously to the motion of the block, a learned funnel lowers the average maximum loss of achieved progress by 19% relative to constraining the endpoint of each chunk alone, at a similar success rate. With the radial band, 11.3% of the executed motion windows are out of distribution, a rate within the range of held-out demonstrations, compared with 34.1% for an unconstrained search.

papers.title_en: Body Schema Policy: Body as the Vision-Action Interface for Efficient Robot Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Lechen Zhang, Chenyuan Chen, Muxin Zhou, Zewen He, Yoshihiko Nakamura
papers.evidence: 机器人视觉动作策略用于全身移动与操控
papers.tldr: 机器人全身运动与操作策略常依靠大规模模型，仍需针对任务微调；人类则通过身体图式高效组织视觉信息与动作。论文提出身体图式策略BSP，将关节和连杆置于运动学树中，以学习的螺旋运动传递特征，并由各身体部位查询视觉证据以生成动作。BSP的动作块输出速度快于对比策略，且无需空间监督即可形成不同部位的视觉关注。在九项模拟G1任务中，它以比Ψ₀少75倍的参数达到相当表现，成功率近乎为扩散策略的两倍，并验证于真实G1与Fetch。该方法表明，利用身体结构设计视觉—动作接口，可提升机器人全身模仿学习的效率。
papers.abstract_en: Currently, robots can learn whole-body loco-manipulation through scale: the strongest policies have billions of parameters and still need task-specific fine-tuning. Humans have limited processing capacity, yet learn and act efficiently through a body schema that organizes what they see and how they move. We introduce Body Schema Policy (BSP), an imitation learning policy that builds such a schema into the vision-action interface. Its latent body schema places joint and link tokens on the robot's kinematic tree, where learned screw motions carry features between links. Through body-queried vision, each body part retrieves its own visual evidence, which conditions the denoising of its actions. With this inductive bias, BSP returns an action chunk faster than any policy we compare. Compact, body-specific visual readouts also emerge without spatial supervision: manipulation commands depend strongly on task objects, while locomotion commands respond more broadly to the scene. On nine simulated Unitree G1 whole-body tasks, BSP matches the $Ψ_0$ humanoid foundation model with $75\times$ fewer parameters and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy's success. The same holds on a real G1 and a Fetch mobile manipulator.

papers.title_en: Zero-Shot Compositional Generalization for Embodied Manipulation
papers.authors: Baicheng Li, Wenkang Qin, Youqi Pan, Dongxiao Mao, Yukun Zhou, Chuanfu Shen, Dong Wu, Shunkai Zhou, Zike Yan, Wei Sui, Hongbin Zha
papers.evidence: 利用运动学几何监督实现跨机器人构型的零样本操作泛化
papers.tldr: 机器人示范来自不同本体，许多机器人—技能组合缺失，且关节标签受各自运动链限制，难以直接共享。本文将示范命令转为工具空间目标，以标定正向运动学为可执行该命令的其他机器人生成原生动作监督，并用可达性筛选目标。训练兼顾源本体构型重建与跨本体几何监督，执行由目标机器人的原生解码器完成。匹配对照及多骨干、双模拟器评测表明，该方法提升未见组合迁移，为具身操作的零样本组合泛化提供了实证框架。
papers.abstract_en: Robot demonstrations are collected on different embodiments, leaving many robot-skill combinations unobserved. Pooling these data shares visual knowledge, while joint labels remain tied to the demonstrating kinematic chain. We propose a geometry-supervised training framework for zero-shot composition of familiar robots and skills. The central insight is that a demonstrated command provides a tool-space target for every robot that can realize it. Calibrated forward kinematics supplies this supervision to foreign native action interfaces without their joint labels for that skill. Native reconstruction retains demonstrated configurations, and positive reachability checks select targets for cross-robot supervision. A visual policy learns to predict shared actions and executes through the target robot's native decoder. During policy learning, one prediction receives geometric supervision through both source and foreign native realizations. Matched supervision controls, repeated policy training and evaluations across three backbones and two simulators demonstrate improved transfer to missing robot-task combinations.

papers.title_en: Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Zhexuan Zhou, Yanke Sun, Yuhan Zong, Youmin Gong, Jie Mei
papers.evidence: 训练无人机依据自然语言指令在环境中导航并安全避障
papers.tldr: 自然语言引导的无人机导航需要在复杂环境中准确执行指令、跟踪任务进展并安全避障，而现有世界动作模型往往侧重动作预测，难以兼顾这些要求。本文提出整合式世界动作学习框架，以语言条件动作接口及针对性后训练提升指令响应，并通过循环式指令消耗预测判断进度与终止。框架还利用高斯场景后训练，结合轨迹模仿和可微几何反馈改善避障。闭环评测、消融实验及室内外真实飞行表明，该方法提升序列任务完成、安全抵达和及时终止能力；单步去噪也降低推理开销，为可靠语言导航提供了完整方案。
papers.abstract_en: Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.

papers.title_en: Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jongmin Lee, Jaeyeong Kim, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 以SfM几何引导前馈式多视图三维重建细化
papers.tldr: 现有前馈式三维重建虽能一次预测稠密点图，但缺少显式几何约束时，跨视角预测易不一致，细节精度不足。Refin3R以SfM点为几何锚点，将其结构传播到图像网格，并通过二维与三维双分支及双向信息交互联合细化各视图。实验覆盖ScanNet++、ETH3D、Tanks&Temples及人像、手术等域外场景，点图精度持续优于前馈和几何引导基线，且快于最强几何引导方法。该方法展示了将稀疏多视图几何与稠密图像特征协同建模的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.

papers.title_en: PAIR: Bringing Household Robots into the Smart Home
papers.authors: Junseong Pyo, Hyeongjin Kim, Jongwook Han, Seungwon Kook, Sungjib Lim, Yohan Jo
papers.evidence: 家用机器人在智能家居环境中执行物体操作任务，并提供基准与示范。
papers.tldr: 家用机器人需要操作家电，而智能设备既能通过实体面板控制，也提供设备API；现有具身仿真却常把家电仅当作普通物体。作者据Matter协议打造PAIR，纳入84种设备及共享状态联动，并构建40项需物体操作的任务和340条人类示范。两种微调策略在120次评测中均未完成任务；即使有理想计划和API，失败也多卡在导航、抓取与开门，理想身体下最佳规划器仅完成57.3%的计划。结果表明，智能家居机器人研究不能只关注规划与接口选择，还须重视基础身体能力，PAIR为此提供了系统测试基准。
papers.abstract_en: Household robots often need to operate appliances, and smart appliances offer both control panels and device APIs. Existing embodied AI simulation environments, however, model appliances solely as physical objects. We introduce PAIR, a smart-home simulation environment grounded in the Matter protocol~\footnote{https://csa-iot.org/all-solutions/matter/}, the industry standard for smart-home devices. PAIR provides 84 smart-device assets whose functional control panels and APIs act on a shared device state, with ambient conditions that evolve in response to both. From a survey of 1,443 requests, we construct a benchmark of 40 tasks that all require object manipulation yet remain solvable without API access, with 340 human demonstrations for policy training. Whether run alone, with a high-level planner, or with an API-enabled planner, two fine-tuned VLA policies complete none of the 120 evaluation episodes. Robots rarely get far enough to use the API: even with oracle plans and API access, over 90\% of failed rollouts stall at navigating, grasping, or operating a door. With a perfect oracle in place of the robot's body, the best planner still gets through only 57.3\% of its plan. When choosing between pressing a button and calling an API, several planners go by whether they can read the panel, not by API latency.\footnote{We will release our code and data upon publication.}

papers.title_en: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Haosong Peng, Xiangyang Liu, Zhengshen Zhang, Yunfeng Fan, Tianyu Qi, Xin Xia, Yufeng Zhan, Wenchao Xu
papers.evidence: 从视频恢复机器人末端位姿与夹爪状态，并生成未来操作轨迹
papers.tldr: 机器人操作视频蕴含丰富动作信息，但仅凭单目RGB恢复动作、夹爪状态及场景几何仍具挑战，不同本体间的数据也难以复用。TCP4D以工具中心点位姿为统一动作空间，共用四维场景表示跟踪已观测运动并生成未来轨迹；它还能重定向视频中的动作、合成替代本体示范，无需源机器人状态记录。跟踪在DROID与RoboLab的绝对轨迹误差分别为7.60和16.07毫米，生成在RoboTwin平均成功率达69.19%，联合训练较仅用增强数据提升41.5%。该方法降低动作标注依赖，并展现跨本体迁移与真实操作应用潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.

papers.title_en: $π^4$: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
papers.authors: Yifan Wang, Weiguang Zhao, Ni Yang, Haoyu Guo, Junting Dong, Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen
papers.evidence: 从非标定图像恢复稠密几何、相机位姿与运动
papers.tldr: 真实场景图像往往未标定，输入还可能是单张照片、无序多视图或视频，因此同时恢复场景几何、相机姿态、尺度与物体运动并不容易。π⁴以统一基础模型处理这些输入，几何分支负责重建，几何条件运动分支预测图像对应关系并结合目标视图几何提升至三维。模型在几何评测中取得最佳总体平均排名，在二维、三维点跟踪和动态物体分割上也具竞争力。系统约五亿参数，可一次前向联合重建与跟踪，并处理数千张输入图像。
papers.abstract_en: $π^4$ is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, $π^4$ achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.

papers.title_en: Sim-to-Real Room-Mediated Object-Goal Navigation with ROS 2 and Nav2
papers.authors: Matthew Chua, Adam Scicluna, Gavin Paul
papers.evidence: 在真实机器人上部署并评估物体目标导航策略
papers.tldr: 物体目标导航方法多在可重复的仿真环境中评估，真实机器人部署及语义先验的泛化能力仍缺少验证。本文将基于房间概率向量的 Room-Mediated Co-occurrence 策略，通过机器人无关的 ROS 2 桥接部署到 Spot 与 TurtleBot 4，并适配感知、定位和动作接口。在 Spot 上针对 11 类物体、两个起点进行了 66 次试验，成功率为 0.455，较仿真报告的 0.539 低 8.4 个百分点。分析指出玻璃墙漏检、禁入区域、深度感知距离、目标尺寸及房间词汇与实际布局不符可能造成落差，为语义导航策略走向真实部署提供了实证与改进方向。
papers.abstract_en: Although object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) approaches are usually evaluated in simulation, which offers scale and repeatable environments, real-world deployments are rarely examined beyond feasibility demonstrations. This paper presents the deployment of Room-Mediated Co-occurrence, an ObjectNav policy that reasons over Room Probability Vectors (RPVs), on two robotic platforms (Boston Dynamics Spot and Clearpath Robotics TurtleBot 4) through a robot-agnostic ROS 2 bridge. We study how these semantic priors generalise to physical environments and describe the adaptations required to transfer RPV from simulation to hardware, covering sensing, localisation, and the action interface. Across 66 trials on Spot, searching for 11 object categories from two starting positions in a university postgraduate research facility, RPV achieves a raw Success Rate (SR) of 0.455. Our analysis identifies undetected glass walls, entry into off-limits areas, limited usable depth range, target size, and mismatch between the room lexicon and physical layout as plausible contributors to the 8.4 percentage-point gap between the real-world SR and the reported simulated SR of 0.539. Code is available at https://github.com/Matthew-K-Chua/rpv-ros2-bridge.

papers.title_en: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Rongxin Gao, Dongxuan Liu, Chu Li, Chengyang Ji, Jialing Huang, Runyu Chen, Kairun Wen, Chenxin Li, Jingrui Ye, Haosong Zhen, Xinghao Ding, Yue Huang, Yuzhi Huang, Xiaodong Tu, Jingyan Jiang
papers.evidence: 以潜在世界模型预测环境的未来动态
papers.tldr: 单目视频中的动态空间推理既要解释已观测到的三维变化，也要预测视频结束后的未来演化；现有方法偏重回顾理解，且依赖几何处理或文字描述，容易增加推理成本、损失连续动态信息。Pros4D将观测动态压缩为潜在状态，并自回归滚动生成未来状态，以视觉语义、几何及语言监督对齐潜在表征。框架配套构建几何标注数据与覆盖八类任务的评测基准，在多个基准上均优于强基线。该工作以统一的四维潜在世界状态连接历史理解和未来预测，为动态环境中的空间推理提供可预测、信息紧凑的表示。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

papers.title_en: DiffWAM: Learning World Action Model from Consecutive Visual Difference
papers.authors: Xinheng Zhang, Haoyu Xiong, Chao Jing, Xiaohan Zhang, Linshan Li, Hongbang Fan, Xingyu Chen
papers.evidence: 机器人世界动作模型联合预测场景变化与动作
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型联合预测未来场景与机器人动作，但未来状态包含大量静态背景等无关内容，可能干扰对任务相关变化的学习。DiffWAM采用混合专家框架，额外预测连续观测潜在表征之间的视觉差异，以突出轨迹中的时序变化。推理时可移除世界与差分专家，因此不增加额外开销。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实操作任务上均优于FastWAM，成功率分别达到98.8%、92.65%和88.3%，展示了差分监督提升机器人操作能力的价值。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.

papers.title_en: MoViC: Real-Time Humanoid Whole-Body Control from Monocular Video Streams
papers.authors: Yimin Han, Jiahui Zhang, Wanyue Li, Zeren Luo, Yeke Chen, Liu Zhao, Peizhuo Li, Xiaoyu Ji, Shihao Dong, Xuechao Chen, Zhangguo Yu, Annan Tang, Peng Lu
papers.evidence: 结合视觉感知与学习策略控制人形机器人全身动作
papers.tldr: 人形机器人若要从普通单目视频实时模仿全身动作，既需准确重建人体运动，也要弥合视觉处理与控制执行的速度差异。MoViC融合单目动作重建、机器人动作重定向和基于变换器的行为策略，以单步参考及紧凑频域运动表征提供动作提示与时间上下文。部署时，外推方法连接每秒10次视觉估计和每秒50次策略控制，支持异步运行。硬件实验展示了高动态动作跟踪，以及仅凭实时单目彩色视频完成双臂与单臂操作，为无穿戴设备的机器人遥操作提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time whole-body imitation from monocular video requires both a robust universal tracker and high-quality real-time reconstruction. We present MoViC, a framework that uses live RGB video as a control signal for humanoid robots without wearable tracking devices. The framework combines monocular human motion reconstruction, robot retargeting, and a transformer-based behavior foundation model. The policy receives proprioceptive history, a single explicit next-step reference, and a compact frequency-domain motion representation that supplies temporal context without explicitly stacking future reference frames, which reduces the input dimension and network size. During deployment, our extrapolation method bridges the 10-Hz visual estimation with 50-Hz controller, enabling asynchronous visual processing and policy execution. Hardware experiments further demonstrate highly dynamic motion tracking and device-free teleoperation of bimanual and single-arm manipulation tasks from live monocular RGB input. Project page: https://movicproject.github.io/ .

papers.title_en: EgoSwarm: Learning Decentralized Robot Swarm Intelligence from Human Swarm Demonstrations
papers.authors: Ziqiang Liu, Xitong Chen, Min Li, Yiqun Li, Zhuoping Yin
papers.evidence: 从人类群体示范学习分布式机器人协作
papers.tldr: 多机器人协作需要分工、交接与共同操作，但现有学习方法主要依赖单体示范，难以监督智能体间动作依赖，规模化采集机器人群体示范也困难。EgoSwarm利用多人第一视角协作数据，提出群体交互数据包与令牌，从分布式观察恢复跨智能体关系，并转化为符合部署信息约束的局部监督。基于此训练SwarmVLA，以局部观察、历史和有限邻居消息驱动去中心化策略，在三类任务上平均成功率达72.2%。该工作展示了从人类群体经验学习可扩展机器人群体协作的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Advancing from individual embodied intelligence to swarm embodied intelligence is a key step toward scalable, general-purpose embodied intelligence. Complex tasks often require multiple agents to divide responsibilities, coordinate handovers, and manipulate shared objects collaboratively. However, existing robot learning methods rely primarily on individual demonstrations, which provide limited supervision for modeling dependencies among agent actions, while collecting multi-robot demonstrations at scale remains difficult. Human egocentric demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, yet distributed observations from multiple participants cannot directly supervise decentralized policies. We introduce EgoSwarm, the first robot learning framework for learning decentralized multi-robot collaboration from human swarm demonstrations. EgoSwarm collects more than 50 hours of collaborative experience using a robot-free multi-person egocentric system. We introduce the Swarm Interaction Packet (SIP) and Swarm Interaction Token (SIT) to recover cross-agent interaction relations from distributed observations and transform this experience into local supervision consistent with deployment-time information constraints. We further propose SwarmVLA, which transfers knowledge of swarm behavior to decentralized policies conditioned on local observations, local history, and limited neighbor messages. SwarmVLA achieves a mean success rate of 72.2% across three categories of multi-robot collaborative tasks. Project page:https://xitong-c.github.io/EgoSwarm_Page/.

papers.title_en: Every Camera Grows Up: Camera-Height Regression in Interactive Video World Models
papers.authors: Sheng Lu, Guangpin Tao, Tong Lu, Ying Tai
papers.evidence: 评估供具身智能体使用的交互式视频世界模型
papers.tldr: 交互式视频世界模型依据起始图像和动作生成视角，理应在运动中维持相机真实高度；论文发现模型会把低机位逐步拉向人眼高度。作者提出 EyeHeight 基准，结合六种合成高度、四种真实标定机位及无尺度多视图高度估计，评测六个开放权重模型。180度转向行走后，起始高度为0.15米的片段仅0—20%仍接近原高度，推断视点趋于1.1—1.5米；漂移随转角增大，也会改变导航策略路径。研究将此现象联系到人类中心视频先验，并发现无引导采样与高度均衡微调可改善高度保持，但会降低画质。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models serve as simulators for embodied agents: from a starting image and an action trajectory, they generate the views the agent would see. The starting image fixes how high the camera is, for example 0.15 m for a floor robot or 2.2 m for an overhead camera, and a faithful simulator must keep this height as the camera moves. We show that six recent open-weight models fail to do so: as motion replaces the starting view with generated content, they move the camera toward human eye level, a failure we call camera-height regression. Our benchmark, EyeHeight, pairs six rendered elevations (0.15 m to 2.2 m) and four calibrated real-world rig heights with scale-free multi-view height estimation. All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent. In Matrix-Game models, homography-tracked floor motion stays consistent with constant elevation during rotation even as newly outpainted room geometry yields a higher reconstructed viewpoint. Regression grows with rotation angle, begins while the start frame remains in context, and largely reverses in SANA-WM when a $360^\circ$ turn restores the initial view. We trace this pull to human-centric video priors in which floor-level views are nearly absent: in SANA-WM, textual height cues and dense floor-disparity maps do not prevent it, whereas classifier-free text guidance during the first half of denoising strengthens it. Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps. Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.

papers.title_en: ASTRA: ASV Simulator for Transferable Realistic Autonomy
papers.authors: Tsimafei Lazouski, Cody Sheltraw, Alan Papalia, Maani Ghaffari
papers.evidence: 在Isaac Sim中整合海上机器人动力学、感知渲染与自主接口
papers.tldr: 海上自主水面艇的实地测试成本高且难以复现，现有仿真工具在动力学、视觉与机器人接口方面各有侧重。ASTRA基于英伟达仿真平台构建，将福森船舶动力学、几何浮力、可编程谱波扰动、逼真感知及机器人操作系统接口整合于同一环境，并复现蓝船测试艇的传感器配置。零推进实验显示，横摇呈预期的非振荡静水恢复特性，升沉与波场高度相干，主导波频处增益约为一。该开源框架可支持海上自主系统开发、仿真基准评测及仿真到实艇迁移研究。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomy development for marine autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) remains challenging because field testing is costly and difficult to reproduce. Existing marine simulation tools provide mature capabilities in vessel dynamics, robotics integration, and visual rendering, but these strengths are emphasized differently across platforms. This paper presents ASTRA, an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and Robot Operating System (ROS 2) autonomy interfaces within a common environment. ASTRA incorporates a Fossen-style marine dynamics model together with geometry-based buoyancy and programmable spectral wave disturbances, enabling non-planar hydrostatic and wave-induced motion. The simulator reproduces the sensor configuration of a physical BlueBoat testbed, including GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and RGB-D sensing exposed through ROS 2. This allows localization, perception, planning, and control software to be developed against interfaces consistent with the physical platform. The BlueBoat's existing ROS 2 localization and perception modules were ported directly into ASTRA, while targeted zero-propulsion experiments were used to verify the implemented wave-body coupling. The simulated roll response was consistent with the expected non-oscillatory hydrostatic behavior, and heave remained highly coherent with the generated wave field, with approximately unity gain at the dominant wave frequency in the tested sea states. ASTRA is intended as an open-source testbed for marine autonomy development, simulation-based benchmarking, and sim-to-real experimentation.

papers.title_en: ReLAP: Latent Action Pretraining through Recurrent Video Prediction in JEPA Space
papers.authors: R. Gnana Praveen, Ali Rouzbayani, Zhiying Jiang, Bidhan Roy
papers.evidence: 从视频交互中学习潜在动作并预测未来状态
papers.tldr: 机器人学习可从无动作标注视频中提取丰富的交互信息，但潜在动作不仅要描述局部状态变化，还需刻画变化如何随时间演进。ReLAP在冻结的JEPA特征空间中联合学习相邻帧逆动力学与循环多步预测，并将所得表示迁移到视觉语言模型，再用机器人演示适配控制。仅用1100万预训练样本，模型在LIBERO取得97.9%，在LIBERO-Plus扰动测试取得70.0%，LARY两项指标排名第二。结果说明循环式潜在动作预训练能形成紧凑、时间连贯且可迁移的机器人控制表示。
papers.abstract_en: Videos provide a rich source of physical interaction for learning robot behavior without action annotations, yet effective latent actions must capture not only local transitions but also how those transitions evolve over time. We introduce ReLAP, a latent-action pretraining framework that couples local transition learning with recurrent multi-step prediction in a frozen JEPA representation space. A shared inverse dynamics model infers compact continuous latent actions from adjacent observations, while a latent world model recurrently predicts the future JEPA features. Because each predicted feature becomes the context for the next transition, errors at later steps backpropagate through the rollout to earlier latent actions, encouraging temporally coherent dynamics beyond pairwise reconstruction. We transfer this representation to a vision-language model using two complementary objectives: latent distillation from the frozen inverse teacher and recurrent future-feature prediction through the frozen latent world model. The resulting policy is then adapted to robot demonstrations with action flow matching. At deployment, the explicit latent-action and world-model branches are removed, and the fine-tuned VLM predicts physical actions directly, reducing inference complexity. With only 11M pretraining samples and 1.06B trainable parameters, ReLAP achieves 97.9% on standard LIBERO and 70.0% over zero-shot LIBERO-Plus perturbations. On the LARY latent-action benchmark, ReLAP ranks second in both mean regression error and mean classification accuracy among the compared methods. These results demonstrate that recurrent action-free latent action pretraining can learn compact, temporally structured, and transferable representations for downstream robot control.

papers.title_en: CRA: Continuous Risk Assessment for Safety-critical Visual Navigation
papers.authors: Lihao Zheng, Ying Wu, Chen Jiang, Randy Freeman
papers.evidence: 视觉导航中的环境风险感知与安全移动
papers.tldr: 安全关键导航常用预设约束划分安全与危险区域，但现实风险会随对象运动、物理属性和交互情境连续变化。本文提出基于视觉的连续风险评估框架，利用 RGB 与激光雷达估计动能、潜在、接触严重度和热风险，并融合成对象或人员的连续风险分数。系统将风险估计接入泊松安全函数与拉普拉斯引导场构成的安全过滤器，实现在线监测和干预。作者在模拟餐厅场景中展示该方法，旨在支持开放世界机器人导航中更细致的安全响应。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional safety-critical control methods often rely on predefined constraints that separate states into safe and unsafe regions. While recent studies have extended geometric safety toward semantic safety, real-world safety is rarely purely binary. The risk associated with an object or human can vary continuously with its physical properties, like motion, and interaction context; for example, a person carrying a heavy object or a hot object moving at high speed may require a different safety response from an ordinary static obstacle. In this paper, we propose a vision-based continuous risk assessment framework for safety-critical visual navigation. Our method uses RGB and LiDAR observations to estimate four risk factors (kinetic, potential, contact-severity, and thermal) and combines them into a continuous risk score for each assessed object or person. These estimates are integrated into a Poisson safety function with a Laplace guidance field as a safety filter, enabling online monitoring and intervention in open-world robot navigation. We demonstrate the proposed method in a simulated restaurant scene.

papers.title_en: EgoHandWAM: Probing the Role of Hand Motion in Egocentric World Action Modeling
papers.authors: Kailin Wang, Haoxiang Jie, Yaoyuan Yan, Zhiyou Heng, Zhaosong Li
papers.evidence: 从第一视角手部状态预测三维轨迹与未来视觉特征
papers.tldr: 第一人称相机下一刻会看到什么，手部运动能提供多少线索，是理解自我中心动作与视觉变化的关键问题。EgoHandWAM 利用当前图像和近期手部状态，预测三维腕部、指尖轨迹及未来视觉特征，并在大规模 EgoDex 窗口上训练。开发集结果显示，动作预测将两秒腕部终点误差由 60.26 降至 56.48 毫米，但仍低估远距离伸手；视觉预测仅获小幅改善，且依赖真实手部历史。实验表明，手部运动对短期预测有用，却不足以带来稳定的机器人任务成功率提升。
papers.abstract_en: How much does hand motion tell us about what a first-person camera will see next? EgoHandWAM forecasts three-dimensional wrist and fingertip trajectories and a future visual feature from the current image and recent hand states. We train on 751,065 EgoDex windows using a frozen DINOv2 encoder. On held-out development sessions, the action-only model reduces two-second wrist endpoint error from 60.26 to 56.48~mm relative to a stationary forecast. It still underestimates long reaches. Adding future-feature supervision gives nearly identical trajectory accuracy. With the recorded hand history, the visual head reduces smooth L1 error by 1.32\% relative to copying the current feature. Shuffling histories across sessions erases this gain. In a separate four-task probe, adding recorded future displacements to observed context and future tracking-validity masks reduces visual-feature error by 3.93\%. Masks alone give little improvement. A trajectory predicted from the same observations adds little. On two simulated RoboTwin tasks, substituting aligned human examples for an auxiliary batch of robot examples gives no consistent increase in task success across three training seeds.

papers.title_en: Accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting Training through Selective Freezing and Computation Caching
papers.authors: He Zhu, Zhiheng Dai, Zihan Liu, Ruyang Li, Hui Wei, Yaqian Zhao, Han Zhao, Xiaofeng Hou, Chen Chen, Jingwen Leng, Yu Feng, Minyi Guo
papers.evidence: 通过冻结与缓存加速三维高斯场景重建训练
papers.tldr: 3D高斯泼溅是沉浸式三维应用的重要表示，但训练开销较大，梯度累积尤其构成瓶颈；现有加速方案要么收益有限，要么影响重建质量。论文提出ElsaGS，利用多数高斯较早收敛的特点，动态冻结已收敛高斯并缓存其累积贡献，从而减少前向光栅化与反向梯度累积计算，并配套设计专用硬件架构。在三个数据集上，最多冻结90%的高斯且质量损失可忽略，较GPU实现端到端提速最高20.6倍、能耗降低99.4%。该方法实现算法与硬件协同优化，为降低3DGS训练成本提供了有效路径。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) becomes a key primitive for immersive 3D experiences. However, its applicability is limited by its long training overhead. Although prior work has shown that gradient accumulation is the dominant bottleneck in training, existing works either have limited speedup or degrade reconstruction quality. To address this issue, we present ElsaGS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed framework that accelerates 3DGS training with negligible accuracy degradation. Our key observation is that most Gaussians converge early, while later iterations only refine a small subset of Gaussians. Thus, we propose a technique, progressive Gaussian freezing, which dynamically freezes well-converged Gaussians and caches their cumulative contributions, thereby reducing computations in both forward rasterization and backward gradient accumulation. To make caching efficient, we further propose an architecture, ElsaGS core, which integrates a pixel-parallel rasterization array with a set-associative frozen Gaussian cache, FGcache. Across three 3DGS datasets, ElsaGS freezes up to 90% of Gaussians with negligible quality loss and achieves up to 20.6x end-to-end speedup and 99.4% energy reduction over GPUs.

papers.title_en: CueSplat: Learning to Schedule Sparse Deformation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting on Edge Devices
papers.authors: Qingyuan Tang, He Zhu, Shixuan Sun, Anbang Wu, Jingwen Leng, Minyi Guo, Yu Feng
papers.evidence: 通过高斯形变预测提升动态场景建模效率
papers.tldr: 动态高斯泼溅依赖形变网络逐帧更新全部高斯，计算开销限制其在边缘设备上的应用。CueSplat冻结预训练骨干与高斯集合，利用近期轨迹预测属性，并由轻量路由器结合预测可靠性、渲染贡献和离线场景预算，挑选需要精确更新的高斯。为降低路由开销，系统复用邻近帧的选择结果，并依据漂移信号安排连续三帧全量更新以重建预测历史。在四种主流4DGS算法上，Jetson AGX Orin和Orin NX最高加速6.74倍和8.15倍，平均PSNR损失不超过0.16 dB，为边缘动态渲染提供了高效的后训练优化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Deformation-based 4D Gaussian splatting (4DGS) enables dynamic scene rendering. However, evaluating deformation networks for all Gaussians at every frame is compute-intensive on edge devices. We find that Gaussian trajectories are often locally predictable, yet prediction reliability varies across Gaussians and time. Thus, we propose CueSplat, a post-training framework that exploits local temporal regularity while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen and retaining its Gaussian set. Specifically, CueSplat predicts Gaussian attributes from recent history and uses a lightweight learned router to select exact deformation updates within a scene-specific budget calibrated offline. Selection accounts for prediction reliability and rendering contribution. Selected indices are reused across nearby frames to reduce routing overhead, while selected Gaussians still receive exact updates each frame. To control accumulated prediction error, we use drift signals to schedule three consecutive full-deformation frames that rebuild the prediction history. Evaluated across four mainstream 4DGS algorithms, CueSplat achieves up to $6.74\times$ and $8.15\times$ speedups on Jetson AGX Orin and Orin NX, respectively, with a negligible quality drop (at most $0.16$ dB in dataset-average PSNR).

papers.title_en: ARG-Avatar: Animation-Rendering Guidance for Efficient Feedforward Avatar Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jianjin Xu, Soham Dasgupta, Fernando De la Torre
papers.evidence: 前馈式三维人体化身重建及几何对应建模
papers.tldr: 从图像重建可动画三维人像的前馈方法虽能将推理缩短至数秒，却常靠扩大模型、数据和算力提升效果。ARG-Avatar仅含6800万可训练参数，利用动画与渲染中的几何对应先验，设计FACRoPE注意力和ITR流程，引导头像令牌关注对应图像块。在多数据集且输入不少于两张图像时，它持续优于既有方法；相较LHM++训练序列少4.8倍、算力少14倍、速度快6倍，并在NeuMan上提升2.7分贝PSNR。这表明显式利用几何先验可兼顾重建质量与训练、推理效率。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from images is important for applications such as gaming and augmented reality. Feedforward methods make avatar reconstruction accessible by reducing inference time to a few seconds, but recent approaches rely heavily on scaling model capacity, training data, and computation. We ask whether such scaling is necessary. To this end, we introduce ARG-Avatar, an efficient feedforward framework with only 68M trainable parameters that achieves SOTA reconstruction quality. Our key insight is that 3D animation and rendering already provide strong geometric correspondences that existing methods largely attempt to learn from data. In light of this, we design the Foreground Avatar Coordinate RoPE attention (FACRoPE) and Intermediate Token Rendering (ITR) pipeline to guide avatar tokens to attend to their corresponding patches. Experiments across multiple datasets show that ARG-Avatar consistently outperforms prior methods when using two or more input images. Compared with LHM++, ARG-Avatar uses approximately 9$\times$ fewer trainable parameters, 4.8$\times$ fewer training sequences, and 14$\times$ less training compute, while running 6$\times$ faster and achieving a 2.7 dB PSNR improvement on the out-of-distribution NeuMan benchmark.

papers.title_en: Inertial Video World Models
papers.authors: Yuan Gao, Fan Xu, Yu Guo, Yuxu Lu, Zhengru Fang, Hao Wu, Xiaomeng Huang
papers.evidence: 世界模型预测环境动态及动作后果，与具身智能的内部环境模型相关
papers.tldr: 许多视频世界模型逐步重建场景，缺少显式惯性状态，导致自回归滚动时运动与结构连续性变弱、误差累积并使预测动力学不稳。InertialWorld将惯性设为结构先验，提出惯性记忆：以场景对齐的稠密欧拉网格保存证据，并用绑定规范坐标的持久拉格朗日载体承载局部内容。模型根据动作传输载体，预测下一完整视频状态，再通过学习门控融合传输内容与新预测内容。机器人操作、三维游戏模拟和开放世界导航实验显示，其自回归预测表现可与强基线竞争，为连续视频预测提供显式状态演化机制。
papers.abstract_en: The physical world has inertia: it evolves from what already exists rather than being recreated at every instant. However, many existing video world models lack an explicit mechanism for inertial state evolution, leaving the continuity of motion and structure implicit in video prediction. During autoregressive rollouts, repeated reconstruction can accumulate errors and destabilize the predicted dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce InertialWorld, an Inertial Video World Model that makes inertia a structural prior for autoregressive prediction: existing scene evidence is carried across time rather than reconstructed at every step. Central to this formulation is Inertial Memory, which turns memory from passive predictive context into an evolving video state with two complementary views: a dense Eulerian grid preserves scene-aligned evidence, while persistent Lagrangian carriers bind local content to learned canonical coordinates. At each step, the model transports the carrier content according to action-conditioned motion, predicts the complete next video state from the transported carriers and dense grid, and uses a learned gate to combine transported and newly predicted content into the memory for the next step. Extensive experiments across multiple domains, including robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation, demonstrate that InertialWorld achieves competitive autoregressive prediction performance against strong video world model baselines. Codes link: https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/InertialWorld

papers.title_en: FailureGen: Scalable Robot Failure Data Generation with World Models
papers.authors: Akul Santhosh, Chaitra Sathe, Aastha Jhunjhunwala
papers.evidence: 面向机器人执行失败的世界模型数据生成，关联具身智能学习
papers.tldr: 机器人真实失败样本难以规模化采集，导致学习数据覆盖的失败场景有限，制约失败识别等方法发展。FailureGen微调动作条件Cosmos世界模型，并将失败片段迁移到兼容的成功执行视频中，可加入空间偏移生成连续视频及事件标注。初步评测中，真实与合成数据训练的检测器平均精度为0.51，高于仅用真实数据的0.41；检出失败区间33/36，而基线为28/36。该方法复用已观测失败构造新上下文样本，为扩展机器人失败数据及下游学习提供途径。
papers.abstract_en: Robot failures are difficult to collect at scale, limiting the range of failure scenarios represented in robot learning datasets. We present FailureGen, a method for generating synthetic videos with temporal event annotations by reusing action trajectories from recorded failures. The method comprises four stages: (1) fine-tuning an action-conditioned Cosmos world model on successful and failed real executions; (2) annotating source recordings to identify failure-associated donor segments and compatible successful hosts; (3) transferring donor motion into host contexts, with optional spatial offsets, to generate continuous video rollouts; and (4) annotating and filtering the generated samples according to observed events and visual quality. We study two implementations with different tasks and robot configurations, with visual failure detection serving as one downstream application. In a preliminary comparison, a detector trained on real and generated data achieves an average precision of 0.51, compared with 0.41 using real data alone, and detects 33 of 36 failure intervals, compared with 28 of 36. By reusing observed failures in additional contexts, FailureGen expands the data available for studying robot failures and developing downstream learning methods.
